scope: Explicitly requested model checkpoints and their verified published packages. Frozen build inputs; no community search on built-in cards.

models.label: HobbyLM 1B Computer Use
models.description: LoRA adapter that turns text requests into macOS actions. Requires HobbyLM 1B Instruct; the published workflow uses Apple MLX and a macOS action harness.

sources.runtimeReason: Adapter package only. Requires harims95/hobbylm-1B-instruct plus the publisher's compatible MLX/macOS runtime and action harness. Base weights are separate; no OpenCore Windows adapter is integrated.

models.label: Mano-CUA 2.0 4B
models.description: Qwen3-VL model trained for screenshot understanding and GUI action prediction. GGUF packages include the published vision projector. Desktop action execution requires an action harness.

sources.runtimeReason: Official Apple Silicon MLX 8-bit package. No OpenCore Windows MLX runtime is integrated; choose a GGUF variant for the managed Windows runtime.

models.label: Terminal-RSI 27B
models.description: Qwen3.8 27B checkpoint trained for terminal-agent tasks and recursive self-improvement. ECHO archives and retrieves conversation history within the runtime's working context.

sources.runtimeReason: Publisher conversion for an NVFP4-capable Apple Silicon MLX runtime. No matching OpenCore Windows adapter is integrated; choose a GGUF variant for the managed Windows runtime.

models.label: DiscoveryRSI 27B
models.description: Qwen3.8 27B instruction model for scientific hypotheses, evidence-grounded research planning and experiment critique. ECHO archives and retrieves conversation history within the runtime's working context.

sources.runtimeReason: This publisher's Q2_0 conversion requires a compatible runtime. Its quantization is not verified with the integrated Windows engine.
EXL3 4.0 bpw requires a compatible ExLlamaV3 runtime and sufficient GPU memory. No OpenCore managed adapter for this format is integrated.

models.label: Tiel-Coder 35B A3B APEX-I-MiniPlus V2.1
models.description: Publisher's custom mixed-tensor APEX-I-MiniPlus V2.1 coding checkpoint. Includes the Q8_0 vision projector. This exact edition remains separate from Ornith and Cyber-Tiel checkpoints; vision and MTP acceleration are unverified.

models.label: Tals-coder-flash-02
models.description: Custom 27B ternary coding checkpoint with grafted MTP weights and its published vision projector. This is the Tals edition, kept separate from its Ternary Bonsai training base. Publisher speed claims have not been verified in OpenCore.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires a publisher-compatible llama.cpp build with Hadamard kernels (Prism ML / Pascal). This custom ternary format has no verified OpenCore managed adapter. The vision projector is included; MTP and vision execution remain unverified.

models.label: Kestrel 4B Coder
models.description: Qwen3.5 4B fine-tune for coding, reasoning and tool-use output. Offers the publisher's BF16 checkpoint and Q8_0 GGUF with the vision projector. Automatic tool execution, vision and MTP acceleration are unverified.

models.label: Qwen3.8 27B Jumbo Fusion NEO MAX MTP
models.description: Publisher mixed-precision reasoning and instruction checkpoint. Includes all seven published GGUF options; speed and MTP acceleration claims are unverified.

models.label: Cyber-Tiel Coder 35B A3B MTP
models.description: The exact Cyber-Tiel MTP edition with its published quantizations and vision projector; retained separately from the non-MTP checkpoint.

models.label: Phonon-2.5
models.description: Packed multilingual Parakeet-derived speech recognition checkpoint for 25 languages. The compressed download size is not its runtime memory requirement.

sources.runtimeReason: Packed multilingual speech checkpoint. Its Phonon-2.5 CPU/MLX decoder is different from Phonon-2; the matching managed Windows decoder must be integrated before transcription.

models.label: KAT-Coder V2.5 Dev APEX-I-MiniPlus V2.1
models.description: Publisher custom mixed-tensor coding checkpoint. The separate MTP draft is not counted as a quantization.

models.label: SimpleSD 4B Thinking
models.description: Apple Qwen3-based thinking checkpoint with its original weights and verified same-checkpoint community GGUF quantizations. Subject to Apple model license terms.

models.label: Cortiq Qwopus Dev
models.description: Task-specialized CORTIQ coding checkpoint with four published GGUF precisions and original BF16 weights. The effective parameter budget differs from stored tensor count; performance is unverified.

models.label: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
models.description: Includes NVIDIA’s official 4GB Q4_K_M edition and verified quantizations of its linked BF16 checkpoint. Other precisions have different memory requirements.

models.label: Fibo 2.0 Dev
models.description: Bria image generation and editing pipeline. Includes text encoder, transformer, VAE, processor and scheduler; publisher access terms apply.

sources.runtimeReason: Complete Diffusers BriaFibo2 pipeline; requires a compatible Fibo-2.0 image runtime and publisher access. This architecture is not served by a text-model runtime.

models.label: FLUX 3 Image Klein
models.description: Distilled 5.6B image transformer for generation and image editing, with separate text encoder and VAE. Includes official BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 packages and published GGUF image-transformer variants.

sources.runtimeReason: Complete BFL native image package with its text encoder and autoencoder. Requires the FLUX 3 Image Klein generation runtime and prompt upsampling; this is separate from the PUP text model.
GGUF image transformer. Requires FLUX 3 Image Klein text encoder, VAE and a Flux3Transformer2DModel-compatible image pipeline; it cannot run in the text llama-server.

models.label: MOSS Image NSFW LoRA
models.description: Image LoRA adapter for OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-SFT. Includes the published ComfyUI and Diffusers adapter formats; base model weights are separate.

sources.runtimeReason: Image LoRA adapter. Requires OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-SFT and a compatible image LoRA workflow. Adapter weights are not a standalone image generator.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 NSFW LoRA
models.description: Image LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1. Requires the matching base checkpoint and a compatible image-adapter runtime.

sources.runtimeReason: Image LoRA adapter. Requires Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 and a compatible image LoRA workflow. Adapter weights are not a standalone image generator.

models.label: MOSS Image NSFW LoRA GGUF
models.description: Two F16 GGUF LoRA checkpoints for MOSS-Image-SFT GGUF. This is an adapter, not a standalone image model; install a compatible MOSS GGUF base to generate.

sources.runtimeReason: GGUF adapter package. Requires axiomofmind/Moss-Image-SFT-GGUF and a MOSS-capable stable-diffusion.cpp runtime; these GGUF adapters do not run on the Qwen or Diffusers MOSS base.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 Anatomy Fix LoRA
models.description: Qwen Image 2.1 image-to-image and text-to-image LoRA from perpetual3x. Connect it to the Qwen Image 2.1 base before generating.

models.label: Hi3D v1.0
models.description: Refines an existing coarse mesh using a reference image; includes the publisher's 512 and 1024 transformers and VAE. Geometry only.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the publisher Sparc3D refinement runtime on Linux, compatible NVIDIA CUDA kernels, and a coarse mesh. The Windows adapter has not been integrated or verified.

models.label: Unlimited OCR 2
models.description: Baidu multilingual image and document OCR model. Published checkpoint contains two safetensors shards and tokenizer configuration.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the publisher custom OCR model code, processor and compatible GPU dependencies; no OpenCore OCR runtime adapter has been integrated or verified.

models.label: Qwen3.5 4B 3D Coder
models.description: Qwen3.5 4B coding fine-tune focused on 3D and Three.js. Includes the updated publisher Q4_K_M and Q8_0 GGUF checkpoints and original FP16 weights.

models.label: Sakura-Iris 3B Uncensored
models.description: Iris 3B pixel-space image generation with the publisher Q8 text encoder. Four real image quants; Q8_0 is recommended for fidelity. No VAE is required.

models.label: LFM3 VL 2B
models.description: Liquid AI vision-language model for image and video understanding with text replies. Official GGUF variants include a pinned vision projector. This is not an image generator.

sources.runtimeReason: This original BF16 package requires LFM3 Transformers custom-model support. Choose an official GGUF option for the automatically prepared Windows LFM3 runtime.

models.label: LFM3 1.7B
models.description: Liquid AI 1.73B text and agent model with a convolution, sliding-attention and global-attention architecture. Includes all official GGUF precisions and the original BF16 package.

sources.runtimeReason: This original BF16 package requires LFM3 Transformers custom-model support. Choose an official GGUF option for the automatically prepared Windows LFM3 runtime.

models.label: Carbon-X
models.description: Hugging Face Bio 14.8B Qwen3-based model for DNA understanding and generation with English explanations. Includes original weights, official GGUFs and verified community precisions.

models.label: Apex 35B V1.0
models.description: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B fine-tune for coding, research, tool use and agent tasks. Includes original BF16 weights, every official GGUF precision and verified community quantizations. Vision and action-harness execution require separate validation.
